name: To Hanzo
source:
When a young man, fan of Escaflowne, one day calls a chat line just to see what it's like, by accident he meets Yumi, a mysterious girl. What will happen when they meet? 

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/tohanzo.shtml]Ren'Ai Archives[/url]]
